name: atent-monorepo
description: Atent — Personal Safety & Emergency Assistance Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@atent/types && npm run build --workspace=@atent/validation && npm run build --workspace=@atent/config && npm run build --workspace=@atent/shared
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@atent/api && npm run build --workspace=@atent/mobile && npm run build --workspace=@atent/safety-web
